zone.zone_name: Office and Light Industrial OL-2/Multifamily Affordable Housing Overlay (§ 245-83)
zone.applies_to: OL-2 zone: Block 7, Lots 8 and 9; Block 6, Lot 14; Block 116, Lots 5.01-5.52 and 6 (north side of Route 46 / Boulevard)
zone.permitted_uses: Uses of the underlying OL-2 zone (§ 245-79), plus multifamily inclusionary development of townhouses and/or multifamily dwellings, with accessory recreation facilities and amenities for residents
zone.setbacks: Front 75 ft; side 50 ft; rear 75 ft; 50-ft landscaped buffer to any residential zone boundary
zone.parking: Per NJ RSIS; no parking within 50 ft of a front lot line or 25 ft of any other lot line
zone.other_standards: Max 8 townhouse units per building; max 16 units in a two-story and 24 units in a three-story multifamily building. Building spacing: windowless-windowless 25 ft, window-windowless 30 ft, window-window front-to-front 75 ft, rear-to-rear 50 ft, end-to-end 35 ft. Density raised from 14 to 16 du/ac and set-aside from 15% rental/20% sale to 20% (Third Round overlay amended). Affordable units per Article XVII (Affordable Housing Ordinance). max_units = Table 23 total for the sites in this zone.

properties.address: Jerseyville Avenue at the Freehold Borough border
properties.existing_conditions: Former Nestle coffee plant, closed November 2023; plant building to be demolished
properties.plan_doc: Freehold Twp Amended Round 4 HEFSP (Thomas Planning; adopted 6/19/25, amended 1/19/26; PB hearing 3/5/26, TC endorsed R-26-64 3/10/26)
properties.notes: 45.3-acre property split with Freehold Borough (26.8 ac in the Borough); only the 18.5 Township acres counted. Lot 34 stays open space.

zone.zone_name: Nestle Redevelopment Zone (Nestle Plant Site Redevelopment Plan)
zone.applies_to: Block 43, Lots 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33 and 34 (Township portion of the Nestle plant, about 18.5 acres)
zone.permitted_uses: Multi-family (non-age-restricted) family rental residential; accessory recreation/common elements, parking, EV charging, signs, bike storage, stormwater facilities, passive recreation, paths, fences up to 6 ft, refuse enclosures
zone.min_lot_area: 15 acres (applies to the redevelopment area as a whole)
zone.setbacks: Principal building: front 100 ft, rear 100 ft, side 75 ft; 100 ft between residential and non-residential uses; parking 25 ft from all property lines
zone.parking: Per NJ RSIS and Sec. 190-162; EV charging per state law
zone.other_standards: Amendment (Ord. O-26-10) raised density from 18 to 20 UPA and set-aside from 20% to 22% (78 affordable). FAR 0.5. Density/FAR on minimum developable area (excludes floodplain, wetlands and buffers, steep slopes, high water table). 50 ft scenic corridor buffer along the railroad; 25 ft landscaped buffer on Jerseyville Ave; 25-30% of tract as common open space; clubhouse at least 1,200 sf (15 sf per unit) operating by 50% of COs; Lot 34 kept as open space; Township part of the Nestle building to be demolished. Planning Board may not waive height by more than 10 ft or 10%.
zone.ordinance_status: Adopted Ord. O-25-24 (11/10/2025); amended by Ord. O-26-10 (introduced 2/10/2026)
zone.plan_doc: Freehold Twp Amended Round 4 HEFSP (Thomas Planning; adopted 6/19/25, amended 1/19/26; PB hearing 3/5/26, TC endorsed R-26-64 3/10/26)

zone.parking: Residential RSIS; non-residential 1 per 250 sf; loading 1 per 20,000 sf

properties.site_name: Metuchen Arts District Redevelopment Plan, Parcel B (North of Wernik)
properties.zoning: Arts District Redevelopment Plan Parcel B (8 du/ac base, 24 du/ac overlay)
properties.plan_doc: Metuchen 2025 HEFSP (Final, dated 5/20/25, corrected 5/22/25)
properties.notes: 16 affordable units (24 credits with 8 bonus) toward the Fourth Round adjusted obligation. 24 du/ac is the overlay density that needs a redevelopment agreement. The HEFSP narrative and the redevelopment plan say Block 145, but the HEFSP Vacant Land Analysis (tax assessor data, App. A) lists these lots as Block 145.01 (Lot 2 0.57 ac; Lots 6, 85-88, 89-91, 92-94 Arjess Corp / Arnolt Bros, B-3/RDP), so Block 145.01 is used. The redevelopment plan also lists Lots 9 and 13.01 in Parcel B.

zone.zone_name: Metuchen Arts District Redevelopment Plan, Parcel B (North of Wernik)
zone.permitted_uses: Arts and commercial uses fronting Main Street; a PURD with at least two of: townhomes or stacked townhomes, up to 2 upper-floor units in an existing Main Street building, live/work units, carriage-house ADUs. Multifamily allowed in a building fronting Calvin Place and/or Wernik Place. Pocket parks and public facilities also allowed.
zone.max_height: 3 stories / 40 ft fronting Main St; 3.5 stories / 45 ft otherwise
zone.setbacks: Main St: prevailing setback; all other parcel lines 10 ft
zone.parking: Residential 1.00 space per unit (including live/work); non-residential per §110-154
zone.other_standards: Base density 8 du/ac and FAR 0.50. The overlay allows 24 du/ac and FAR 1.00 with an executed redevelopment agreement. The HEFSP expects 16 affordable units.
zone.plan_doc: Metuchen Arts District Redevelopment Plan (amended through April 2025, Ord. 2025-10); Metuchen 2025 HEFSP (Final, dated 5/20/25, corrected 5/22/25)
